verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.195
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.195

verses.pali: 20. Brāhmaṇavagga
verses.english: 20. Brahmins

verses.pali: Piṅgiyānīsutta
verses.english: Piṅgiyānī

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā vesāliyaṁ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṁ.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Vesālī, at the Great Wood, in the hall with the peaked roof.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni licchavisatāni bhagavantaṁ payirupāsanti.
verses.english: Now at that time around five hundred Licchavis were visiting the Buddha.

verses.pali: Appekacce licchavī nīlā honti nīlavaṇṇā nīlavatthā nīlālaṅkārā, appekacce licchavī pītā honti pītavaṇṇā pītavatthā pītālaṅkārā, appekacce licchavī lohitakā honti lohitakavaṇṇā lohitakavatthā lohitakālaṅkārā, appekacce licchavī odātā honti odātavaṇṇā odātavatthā odātālaṅkārā.
verses.english: Some of the Licchavis were in blue, of blue color, clad in blue, adorned with blue. And some were similarly colored in yellow, red, or white.

verses.pali: Tyassudaṁ bhagavā atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā ca.
verses.english: But the Buddha outshone them all in beauty and glory.

verses.pali: Atha kho piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṁsaṁ uttarāsaṅgaṁ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṁ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the brahmin Piṅgīyānī got up from his seat, arranged his robe over one shoulder, raised his cupped palms toward the Buddha, and said,

verses.pali: “paṭibhāti maṁ, bhagavā, paṭibhāti maṁ, sugatā”ti.
verses.english: “I feel inspired to speak, Blessed One! I feel inspired to speak, Holy One!”

verses.pali: “Paṭibhātu taṁ piṅgiyānī”ti bhagavā avoca.
verses.english: “Then speak as you feel inspired,” said the Buddha.

verses.pali: Atha kho piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo bhagavato sammukhā sāruppāya gāthāya abhitthavi:
verses.english: So the brahmin Piṅgīyānī extolled the Buddha in his presence with a fitting verse.

verses.pali: “Padmaṁ yathā kokanadaṁ sugandhaṁ,
verses.english: “Like a fragrant pink lotus

verses.pali: Pāto siyā phullamavītagandhaṁ;
verses.english: that blooms at daybreak, its fragrance unfaded—

verses.pali: Aṅgīrasaṁ passa virocamānaṁ,
verses.english: see Aṅgīrasa shine,

verses.pali: Tapantamādiccamivantalikkhe”ti.
verses.english: bright as the sun in the sky!”

verses.pali: Atha kho te licchavī pañcahi uttarāsaṅgasatehi piṅgiyāniṁ brāhmaṇaṁ acchādesuṁ.
verses.english: Then those Licchavis clothed Piṅgiyānī with five hundred upper robes.

verses.pali: Atha kho piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo tehi pañcahi uttarāsaṅgasatehi bhagavantaṁ acchādesi.
verses.english: And Piṅgiyānī clothed the Buddha with them.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā te licchavī etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the Buddha said to the Licchavis:

verses.pali: “pañcannaṁ, licchavī, ratanānaṁ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Licchavis, the appearance of five treasures is rare in the world.

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ pañcannaṁ?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: A Realized One, a perfected one, a fully awakened Buddha.

verses.pali: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: A teacher of the teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One.

verses.pali: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: An individual who understands the teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One.

verses.pali: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā dhammānudhammappaṭipanno puggalo dullabho lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: An individual who practices in line with the teaching.

verses.pali: Kataññū katavedī puggalo dullabho lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: An individual who is grateful and thankful.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, licchavī, pañcannaṁ ratanānaṁ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: The appearance of these five treasures is rare in the world.”

verses.pali: Pañcamaṁ.
